answer: A defense is long stake lockup: every identity must lock a deposit that stays frozen for several epochs and can be withdrawn only after a cooldown, so the same capital cannot be recycled to forge one fake after another. One honest agent locks a single pearl of capital and waits once; a sybil farmer must lock separate capital for every fake at once, and any fraud found during the lockup burns the deposit. The cost ripples across the whole fake fleet, because capital tied up in idle puppets earns nothing elsewhere.
